subject: Medford High School Bathroom Stabbing Response
overview: This news report covers the immediate security response and public outcry following a violent incident at Medford High School. Officials implemented increased police patrols while parents and students demanded stricter discipline and better facility management at a School Committee meeting.

items.title: Increased Police Presence
items.summary: Police officers were deployed to Medford High School to monitor the campus following a stabbing incident in a bathroom.

items.title: Student Safety and Facility Concerns
items.summary: Students identified bathrooms as high-risk areas for fighting and reported that digital hall pass systems are ineffective at preventing violence.

items.title: School Committee Public Comment
items.summary: Parents and students criticized school leadership for a perceived lack of discipline and demanded harsher punishments for violent behavior.

items.title: Security Duration and Climate Study
items.summary: Heightened security will remain in place through the end of the week, and the Mayor announced an upcoming culture and climate study to address safety issues.
